I acknowledge and agree to the following responsibilities related to the delivery and safekeeping of my assigned asset:

  1. Availability

    I will be available at the confirmed address to receive the asset from the consignee and ensure smooth handover.

  2. Coordination and Full Cooperation

    I will actively coordinate and fully cooperate with the Asset Team and the delivery driver to ensure the successful completion of the deployment process. This includes:

    • Responding promptly to any instructions or updates provided by the Asset Team.
    • Complying with all measures or actions required during the process (e.g., providing updated authorization, confirming details, assisting with courier requirements).
    • Supporting contingency steps such as driver changes, rescheduling, or additional verification requests to avoid delays and ensure the asset is delivered as expected.

  3. Compliance with Documentation

    I understand that delivery success depends on my cooperation, including timely submission of required documents (ID, signature specimen).

  4. Communication

    I will keep my communication lines open during the delivery window to respond to any updates or instructions.

  5. Location Assistance

    I acknowledge that despite providing my address and map details, successful delivery may vary based on the driver's ability to locate the address, and my assistance is crucial.

  6. Potential Cancellation & Delay

    • I understand that delivery may be delayed or canceled due to courier service or logistical challenges such as weather conditions, delayed flights, or other unforeseen reasons. In such cases, the Asset Team will notify me promptly.
    • I acknowledge that in the event of driver cancellations or unforeseen changes, the Asset Team will monitor and promptly notify me of any updates. I understand these circumstances are beyond our control, and I commit to staying responsive and patient while cooperating fully to ensure successful delivery.

  7. Documentation of Asset Condition

    Upon receipt of the asset(s), I will:

    • Record video and photos of the unboxing process.
    • For laptops and monitors, power them on to confirm they are in working condition.

    This documentation ensures verification of the asset's condition and helps identify any damage during handling by the courier or logistics provider.

  8. Post-Delivery Confirmation

    After checking the asset(s), I will report their condition to the Asset Team and the IT Team by clearly stating:

    • Which asset(s) are in working condition
    • Which asset(s) are defective or damaged

  9. Custodian Accountability

    • I will comply with signing the Custodian Accountability Form provided by the Asset Team, which formally acknowledges my responsibility for the asset(s) I have received in good working condition.
    • Record the details of the asset(s) confirmed as functional (serial number, tag ID, description).
    • Establish me as the official custodian of these asset(s) for safekeeping and proper use.
    • Serve as a compliance document for asset tracking and audit purposes.

  10. Financial Accountability

    I understand that if delivery fails due to my failure to perform my part (e.g., not available, incomplete documents, lack of coordination), and a re-shipment is required, I will be held financially accountable for the cost of the second shipment.
